story.ch02.title: The First Weight
story.ch02.summary: The Bamboo anchor is repaired, but a living voice suffers when pressure returns. Lan admits opening an undocumented relief bypass.
story.ch02.s01.title: The Needle at the Gate
story.ch02.s01.line_01: Read first. Turn once. If the needle rises after the flow steadies, leave the second anchor alone and come back.
story.ch02.s01.line_02: The needle jumps every fourth breath. I will compare it with the reading after the repair.
story.ch02.s01.line_03: The supply tags end at the shrine. Past here, it is the old inspection route.
story.ch02.s01.line_04: No reason to leave a shutter open on my way through. The carrier path is behind me; the pressure is ahead.
story.ch02.s01.objective: Inspect the pressure dial, confirm your equipment, and reach the intake chamber.
story.ch02.s01.journal: The baseline needle jumps every fourth breath. Lan’s tool label says to return if pressure rises after the repair and to leave Ashen Peak alone.
story.ch02.s01.repeat_entry: The dial still pulses. My earlier reading is in the journal. This time, reach the chamber.
story.ch02.s01.retreat: Retreat keeps your notes and learned techniques. Unbanked expedition rewards use the normal retreat rate.
story.ch02.s01.dial: Old red paint marks the dial’s unsafe band. The needle crosses it briefly, then drops back.
story.ch02.s02.title: The Grove’s Locked Hand
story.ch02.s02.line_01: The roots have grown around the inspection plates. They are holding the chamber shut, not hunting beyond it.
story.ch02.s02.line_02: The shrine still takes the pressure off my hands. The anchor has not broken completely.
story.ch02.s02.line_03: Intake guardian: restrain unstable entries. Manual inspection remains permitted after the defense frame is disabled.
story.ch02.s02.line_04: That seal is closed around a live channel. I need the frame out of the way before I touch the anchor.
story.ch02.s02.line_05: The frame is down. The roots are loosening, but the dial is still moving. A victory is not a reading.
story.ch02.s02.objective: Defeat the Bamboo Guardian and examine the exposed intake controls.
story.ch02.s02.journal: The Bamboo Guardian guarded a live channel rather than a dead ruin. Its defeated frame has exposed manual controls. The clear proof and pending reward are saved; currency and materials will be banked when I return. Reconnection still remains.
story.ch02.s02.boss_retry: Sweep, roots, then the bolts. Leave room to move when the floor begins to rise.
story.ch02.s02.defeat: The intake remains unrepaired. Your notes are saved; return through the entrance to attempt the chamber again.
story.ch02.s02.repeat_clear: The training frame is quiet. The repaired anchor is not mine to reconnect twice.
story.ch02.s03.title: What Takes the Pressure
story.ch02.s03.line_01: The return line is moving. The water is clear again.
story.ch02.s03.line_03: No—too quickly. Let it through in measures. There are people on the low bank.
story.ch02.s03.line_04: Who is speaking? Can you hear me?
story.ch02.s03.line_05: I hear you. Hold the second—
story.ch02.s03.line_08: The grove is steady and someone else is hurting. I need Lan to hear this.
story.ch02.s03.objective: Reconnect the intake once, listen to the voice, and return safely to Lan.
story.ch02.s03.journal: Reconnection steadied Bamboo Hollow but raised the governor’s load. A voice answered me in the present and spoke of people on the low bank. It asked me to hold the second anchor before the array cut its response. I will not proceed to Ashen Peak yet.
story.ch02.s03.exit: Return to the sanctuary to bank the pending reward. The repaired intake and boss-clear proof are already saved.
story.ch02.s03.control_revisit: The intake has been reconnected. The governor-side needle remains above its earlier reading.
story.ch02.s04.title: Lan Opens the Ledger
story.ch02.s04.line_01: Put your reading beside mine. Higher after the roots settled? Then I have something to tell you before you ask.
story.ch02.s04.line_02: Someone answered through the anchor. The array hurt him when I reconnected it.
story.ch02.s04.line_03: I opened a relief bypass last season. No authorization. Reedbank’s winter requests went unanswered, and the wheel would not turn. I let a little flow around the buffer.
story.ch02.s04.line_04: You knew it would strain the intake?
story.ch02.s04.line_05: I knew it might. I checked it every morning and wrote it in this private page instead of the official log. That is what I hid. The old system was already starving them; my repair made the buffer worse.
story.ch02.s04.line_06: That lamp was my sister Mei’s. She is dead. I keep it burning because I need light to read these figures, not because she is in the flame. I can speak for my tools. I cannot speak for the voice you heard.
story.ch02.s04.objective: Listen to Lan’s confession and discuss the raised pressure.
story.ch02.s04.journal: Lan opened an undocumented bypass last season after Reedbank’s requests failed. It helped the wheel but strained the buffer. He volunteered the truth after the pressure rise; the bypass does not explain the earlier years of decline. The answering voice still needs investigation.
story.ch02.s04.tool_marks: The tool’s teeth match fresh cuts on Lan’s bypass sketch. The page records dates, small flow amounts, and rising buffer readings.
story.ch02.s04.choice_ANGER: You should have told me before I touched the anchor.
story.ch02.s04.response_ANGER: Yes. I thought I could keep you out of it. That left you doing work without the facts. Take the page with you.
story.ch02.s04.choice_PLAN: We need a safer answer than another hidden shutter.
story.ch02.s04.response_PLAN: Agreed. First, make your Foundation strong enough to survive the pressure. Then inspect the release anchor without pretending I know what you will find.
